review_response_tasks.rationale: 空后是单数可数名词，结合其开头音素使用a。an与该词的开头音素不合；a few和many要求复数名词，不能直接接本题的单数名词。
it作use的宾语，回指单数noticeboard。its为物主形式不独立作此宾语；they是主格复数，them是宾格复数，均不与单数板对应。
Every Monday说明习惯，单数Li Hua作主语，谓语writes。write数不符；writing和to write均不能独立作限定谓语。
larger为比较级，than引出before这一前后比较。then为时间副词；that非比较介词/连词；as需as large as结构而非larger as。
Last week和on Friday将事件限定过去，moved为过去式。move/moves为现在式；moving缺少限定助动词。
空格后无名词，ours独立表示our paper，与属于另一班的蓝纸对比。our需接名词；we为主格，us为宾格，均不表此处纸的归属。
want to do是所用结构，to help完整。help缺to；helped时态式/分词不能作want的本句补语；helps为三单限定形式。
There be句型中some spare pins为复数，are正确。has/have不是本句存在句be结构；is数不符。
be interested in是本句表达对工作感兴趣的搭配。at/on/of均不构成该搭配。
we后需限定谓语且Tomorrow指计划的未来，will put up成立。puts up与we数不符；putting up与to put up不能独立作限定谓语。

completed_passage:
Our class has a noticeboard near the library. We use it to share school news. Every Monday, Li Hua writes a short message about our clubs. The words on the board are now larger than before, so more pupils can read them easily.

Last week, the old board was too high for the youngest pupils. Our teacher moved it to a lower place on Friday. We decorated the new space together. The blue paper belongs to another class, but the yellow paper is ours. We brought it from our own classroom.

Some pupils wanted to help with the notices. The teacher showed them where to put each one. There are some spare pins in a box below the board. If you are interested in our work, come and look after lunch. Tomorrow we will put up a new notice about the school music show. I have already finished drawing its title.
